# Polemos Labs — Governed AI Systems for Operational Command

> Polemos Labs is an applied AI studio. We turn fragmented data, manual review,
> and tool sprawl into governed, production-grade AI systems — retrieval,
> agentic workflows, and private model deployments — for finance, logistics,
> and professional services teams that need real operational outcomes.

## About

- **Name:** Polemos Labs (also: Polemos)
- **Website:** https://polemos.in
- **Contact:** hello@polemos.in
- **Type:** Applied AI consultancy and engineering studio
- **Focus:** Governed AI systems for operational command — built to ship,
  not to demo
- **Stance:** Real stakes only. Painful workflow, proprietary data, mandate
  to ship.

## What we do

Polemos Labs designs and ships AI systems that sense what matters and route
the next move while keeping humans in command. We work end-to-end: opportunity
mapping, data ingestion, retrieval and knowledge graphs, agent runtimes,
private model deployment, evaluation, and ongoing operation.

## Services

- **AI Opportunity Mapping** — Identify the workflows worth automating,
  the data required, and the fastest route to measurable production value.
- **Ingestion, Retrieval & Knowledge Graphs** — Pipelines, indexing,
  permissions, and RAG systems that make internal data usable by people,
  agents, and decision systems.
- **Agentic Workflow Automation** — Agents that execute bounded tasks, use
  tools, validate outputs, and hand off to humans at the right moment.
- **Model Deployment & Tuning** — Open-source model deployment, evaluation,
  fine-tuning, and monitoring for teams that need security, cost control,
  and auditability.

## Accelerators (productized foundations)

- **OmniGraph — Grounded Retrieval Layer.** Production retrieval stack with
  hybrid search and rerank, permission-aware grounding, and an eval harness
  for precision, recall, and faithfulness.
- **NeuroTask — Supervised Agent Runtime.** Graph-based agent runtime with
  typed tools, sandboxed least-privilege execution, and human approval gates
  on destructive actions, with full traces.

## Outcomes by industry

- **Finance & Operations** — Invoices move from inbox chaos to controlled
  exception queues. Ingest PDFs, emails, and ERP records; validate against
  policy; escalate only what needs a human.
- **Logistics & Supply Chain** — Demand signals become procurement moves
  before pressure hits. Connect transaction history, supplier data, and live
  operational context so planners act before bottlenecks become expensive.
- **Professional Services** — Institutional knowledge becomes a cited
  analyst layer. Retrieval, citation, and synthesis across contracts,
  research, tickets, and client records.

## How we work

1. **MAP — Discover (2 weeks).** Map high-friction workflows, data readiness,
   risk, and ROI. Output: prioritized implementation brief.
2. **DESIGN — Plan (3 weeks).** Architecture, model strategy, integrations,
   evaluation sets, and human-in-the-loop controls — before code.
3. **DEPLOY — Execute (4–6 weeks).** Ship the first production workflow with
   ingestion, retrieval, agents, tests, observability, and real user feedback.
4. **EXPAND — Command (ongoing).** Harden, expand to adjacent workflows,
   monitor quality and cost, and train the client team to operate the system.

## Who we work with

- Teams with a specific operational bottleneck with measurable cost, delay,
  or risk
- Teams that own proprietary data that should become a strategic advantage
- Teams that need secure deployment across existing tools and approval paths
- Teams that measure success by business outcomes, not model benchmarks
- Teams with the mandate to ship and capacity to own the system after launch

## Technical focus areas

- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), hybrid search, rerankers
- Knowledge graphs and entity resolution over private data
- Agentic workflows on typed state graphs, tool use, approval gates
- Open-source LLM deployment, evaluation, fine-tuning
- AI governance: audit trails, guardrails, observability, cost control
- Permission-aware data layers and secure model serving
